long_title: An Act to consolidate and amend the laws relating to the procedure of the Courts of Civil Judicature.
An Act to define and amend certain parts of the law relating to contracts.
An Act to amend the law relating to the transfer of property by act of parties.
An Act to consolidate and amend the provisions relating to offences.
An Act to consolidate and provide general rules and principles of evidence.
An Act to provide for protection of the interests of consumers.
